work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief VI to the archbishop of Lucca (address LF1012–1013) lets those hearing Mass from Bartolomei’s adjoining room satisfy the precept; complete grant, Non obstantibus and 13 February 1835 closing LF1065–1069 precede numeral VII (OCR pci bl) at LF1072. Own provenance LF1143 excluded. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF1016–1016; the source closing at LF1065–1069 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo _ piscatoris die decima tertia februarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo quinto, pontificatus Nostri anno quinto, Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
